posts.body:
Hi there!
So, little introduction from my side - when I was like 10-11 years old, my brother had RM XP and I liked to play around and draw maps in it. And recently, at some point, I noticed that RPG Maker XP was now free, so I went for a bit of a nostalgia trip to perhaps learn how to use it properly after all these years!
I ended up looking for answers on this forum a lot, but since I get stuck often, and now I got so stuck that I just decided to just make an account here (even though XP is veeery outdated at this point it seems and not commonly used. but can't hurt to still try asking questions about it!)
I'm trying to make a simple, post-apocalyptic puzzle game of a sort. Which maybe sounds kinda weird. You are a cat, to perhaps make it even weirder. It's been a lot of fun though. I really like how it makes me think in unconventional ways at times!

posts.body: It's always great to see that someone (besides a diehard few of us here XD) still loves XP! Welcome aboard!
